messages:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Starting canary rollout: environment=dev-test service=inference-runtime tag=v2.14.0-rc5 rollout_id=rl-20260320-1134 owner=@ashley. Strategy=rolling, batch_size=2 pods, max_unavailable=1. No DB migrations scheduled. ETA ~8m. Link: https://ci.redwood/example/rl-20260320-1134
ashley: ack. I'll watch the traces. canary target is traffic=10% for 5m then increase.
priya: running quick smoke suite against canary: /smoke/inference/basic -> starting now. will report results.
liam: quick q — are we pinning model_config to bert-quant-v1.3 for this canary? last time autoswitch flipped traffic.
ashley: yes pin to bert-quant-v1.3 in the deploy config. added note in rollout metadata.
carlos: hold alerts open on p50 token-latency and error-rate. I'll pause elevs if we see >2% 5m error.
priya: smoke results: all 12 smoke checks passed. sample output looks fine. snippets: ```json
{"request_id":"r-9b1c","latency_ms":112,"status":"ok"}
```
priya: also ran a quick eval on the prompt set; nothing alarming, rouge delta +0.2.
sre-bot: monitoring policy attached: latency_p50_threshold=150ms error_rate_threshold=2.0% notify=#eng-oncall if breached.
deploy-bot: Canary progress update: 2/2 pods up, 10% traffic routed to canary, health_checks=OK.
liam: can we keep a manual hold before promoting to 50%? want to verify traces for key customer routes.
ashley: hold added. promotion will be manual after 10m soak and signoff from @liam and @priya.
priya: +1, I've started targeted tests for customer routes (auth, rerank). will share logs.
carlos: FYI toggled circuit breaker to 80 concurrent requests for canary to avoid overload.
priya: targeted tests green. traces look normal, no 5xx, p95 latency stable. posting a short trace: `trace://abc123`
liam: reviewed traces, looks clean. ok to promote to 50%.
ashley: promoting to 50% now. tagging rollout metadata: promoted_by=@ashley promoted_at=1801234630
deploy-bot: Promotion update: traffic=50% stable, success_rate=99.6%, p95=320ms. Continuing to monitor for 10m.
ashley: quick note — release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.14.0-rc5, please add any customer-facing items.
priya: adding note about quantized model pin and observed latency improvements.
liam: leaving a small rollback plan here: if error_rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 >600ms for 3m -> rollback to v2.14.0-rc4.
ashley: copied rollback plan into rollout metadata.
sre-bot: threshold check: error_rate=0.4% p95=330ms, no alerts.
deploy-bot: Canary complete: promoted to 100% traffic. rollout_id=rl-20260320-1134 final_tag=v2.14.0-rc5 deprecation_note=v2.14.0-rc4. Duration=22m. :white_check_mark:
ashley: thanks everyone. I'll merge notes and cut the release candidate ticket. tagging #product for visibility. :shipit:
priya: marking test fixtures for integration run later today.
liam: pushing a small post-deploy watch doc to run for next 2 hours.
carlos: closing the temporary circuit breaker, restoring normal concurrency.
ashley: closing thread. if anything else crops up ping me or @oncall.
